caveats: Original pinned main and final pinned head are fresh solves with same fixtures/harness/budgets/runtime/dependency tree and serial local resources. They run at different times; full-board walltimes are observational, not an isolated bus speedup.
A timeout can include valid retained partial routes. It is not a completed board.
This core benchmark does not request or establish bus length matching, pair skew or coupling acceptance; routing-only pass must not be called a length-matching pass.

main.busDistributionMatch: Root built the pinned bus source and verified its distribution byte-for-byte identical to the core-installed release before editing.
